name: wp-sc-click-id-alias-partial
description: [PARTIAL AGREEMENT] sc_click_id folds into sccid in BOTH plugin (CLICK_ID_ALIASES + mapQueryFields special case) and engine (PARAM_ALIASES). BUT plugin writes only the sccid field + channel 'Snapchat Ads'; engine additionally infers source=snapchat/medium=cpc.
quirk_decision: DISAGREEMENT (partial): alias folding is shared contract; the engine's snapchat/cpc source-medium inference for bare sccid is engine-only.
